display.purpose: Article titles, page headings. One per view. text-wrap: balance.

label.purpose: Section labels, metadata, badge text. Max 4 words uppercase.

mono-caption.purpose: Topbar path, status bar, timestamps. Structural chrome.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button. Blue background, white text, sharp corners.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.65rem; background: #3b82f6; color: #fff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Source Code Pro', monospace; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2563eb; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action button. Transparent background, muted text.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.65rem; background: transparent; color: rgba(212, 212, 212, 0.50); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Source Code Pro', monospace; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: rgba(212, 212, 212, 0.65); border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Terminal Input
components.description: Command-line style text input. Transparent background, emerald cursor.
components.css: .ds-input-terminal { flex: 1; background: transparent; border: none; color: #d4d4d4; font-family: 'Source Code Pro', monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; outline: none; caret-color: #10b981; padding: 0.75rem 0; } .ds-input-terminal::placeholder { color: rgba(212, 212, 212, 0.40); }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Small tag/badge for categories and labels.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Source Code Pro', monospace; font-size: 0.58rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: rgba(212, 212, 212, 0.50); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-chip:hover { color: #60a5fa; border-color: #3b82f6; }

components.name: Article Card
components.description: Terminal-style list item for article entries.

components.css: .ds-article-entry { display: block; padding: 0.85rem 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s; border-left: 2px solid transparent; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); text-decoration: none; color: inherit; font-family: 'Source Code Pro', monospace; } .ds-article-entry:hover { border-left-color: #3b82f6; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); } .ds-entry-num { color: rgba(212, 212, 212, 0.35); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; margin-right: 0.5rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-entry-title { color: #d4d4d4; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 500; display: inline; } .ds-entry-date { float: right; font-size: 0.65rem; color: rgba(212, 212, 212, 0.35); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Topbar navigation link with active state indicator.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Source Code Pro', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; color: rgba(212, 212, 212, 0.50); text-decoration: none; padding: 0.3rem 0.65rem; transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; border-left: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #d4d4d4; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); } .ds-nav-link.active { color: #d4d4d4; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); border-left-color: #3b82f6; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Status indicator with syntax color coding.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Source Code Pro', monospace; font-size: 0.55rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.15rem 0.4rem; border-radius: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; white-space: nowrap; border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-badge-active { color: #10b981; background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1); border-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); } .ds-badge-risk { color: #f59e0b; background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.08); border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15); }

narrative.overview:
CryptoSynth's design system is built from the command line outward. Every visual decision traces back to one question: would a crypto practitioner who lives in the terminal find this authentic? The aesthetic is not a costume layered over a blog; it IS the blog. Dark backgrounds, monospace typography, syntax-highlighted accents, and the structural rhythm of a terminal interface.

The system explicitly rejects the visual language of its anti-references: no SaaS landing-page polish, no crypto-influencer flash, no traditional-finance stiffness. It also rejects the saturated AI-default patterns: no cream/sand body backgrounds, no editorial-typographic display-serif layouts, no identical card grids.
keyCharacteristics: Terminal chrome as structural element (topbar, status bar, command prompt)
Flat elevation by default; depth through tonal layering
Single font family (Source Code Pro) across all roles
Dark mode as native state, not a toggle

rules.name: The Syntax Rule
rules.body: Accent colors map 1:1 to terminal syntax roles (blue=link, emerald=success, amber=warning, red=error, orange=string). Never use an accent color outside its syntax role.

rules.name: The Depth Stack Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds use exactly three tonal layers: --bg → --bg-elevated → --bg-surface. No additional depth layers. Depth is conveyed through tonal separation, never through shadows or blur.

rules.name: The Muted Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Text uses exactly four opacity levels of the same base color (#d4d4d4): primary (100%) → secondary (65%) → muted (50%) → dim (40%).

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Source Code Pro is the only font family. No display serif, no body sans-serif, no contrast pairing.

rules.name: The Weight-Ladder Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy steps use weight contrast of at least 200 between adjacent levels. Body (400) → Label (600) → Headline (700) → Display (900).

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. No ambient shadows, no glassmorphism, no backdrop-filter blur.

rules.name: The Border-Opacity Rule
rules.body: Borders use white at varying opacities: 0.02 for subtle dividers, 0.04 for card borders, 0.06 for emphasized borders, 0.12 for hover states.

dos: Use the three-layer tonal depth stack for all elevation
Map accent colors to their syntax roles
Use text-wrap: balance on all headings (h1–h3)
Use tabular-nums on all number columns and timestamps
Use non-breaking spaces before units and abbreviations
Use … (U+2026) in all placeholders, never three periods
Guard all keyframe animations with prefers-reduced-motion
Use explicit transition properties, never transition: all
donts: Don't use gradients, glassmorphism, or backdrop-filter blur
Don't use a second font family
Don't use border-radius above 8px on cards
Don't use emoji as decorative elements
Don't use cream, sand, beige, or warm-tinted body backgrounds
